scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-pos "npm test -w tests/rules"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-pos "npm test -w functions"
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/env.mjs prepare dev && ./scripts/build-web.sh dev && firebase deploy --project dev --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/env.mjs prepare staging && ./scripts/build-web.sh staging && firebase deploy --project staging --non-interactive
